被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了最新章节_第9章 差距有点大第1页_被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了一朵青莲_热点小说网
> 第9章 差距有点大（第1页）
“原来是夏师姐，您真会说笑，我就是废人一个，哪里还能炼丹，你指定是弄错了。”
陈长生能够回收废丹的事情除了丹老外，绝对不能让任何人知道，否则的话就是杀身大祸，他自己肯定会被当做小白鼠拿去研究。
“哦，那可能是我弄错了吧！陈长生，我听说过你的故事，确实很凄惨的，男子汉大丈夫何患无妻。对了，你以后要是有什么困难，可以去药园找我，就在你废丹房不远处哦。”
夏雨蝶冲陈长生眨巴了下眼睛，释放出一丝善意。
陈长生抱了抱拳，“多谢夏师姐，感激不尽，师姐慢走。”
夏雨蝶走后，陈长生暗自松了口气，看来以后还是要更加小心才行，尽量放在晚上回收丹药。
另一边，望仙宗一处修行圣地之中，一名女子御剑飞行，很快在降落到门口，正是顾清影的妹妹顾倾城。
炼气弟子也能御剑飞行，只不过飞不远，只能短距离飞行。
这里正是顾清影师门所在地，景色绝美，仙鹤起舞，麋鹿悠闲吃草，满地的奇花异草，落英缤纷，香气满园，仙雾袅袅，彩虹仙桥。
好一片修行圣地，和陈长生那破烂的废丹房相比简直就是两个世界。
守山的弟子见是顾倾城，连忙放她进来。
进入山门，里面更是别有一番洞天，亭台楼阁，花团锦簇，姹紫嫣红，远处的山上还有瀑布落下，像是一挂银河。
仙禽遍地，锦鲤呈祥，朵朵生莲，天花乱坠。
“姐姐，那陈长生一个废物，居然还敢扬言三个月后亲自登门退婚，给他脸了是吧！”
顾倾城一进来就看见姐姐顾清影盘膝坐在亭台里，气呼呼的说道。
“他肯定是气不过，我这样做是不是有点落井下石了？”
顾清影抬起头来，峨眉臻首，眼波流转，柳叶细眉，皓齿朱唇，两姐妹在一起当真是争奇斗艳，桃羞杏让。
顾家姐妹当真是生的娇艳，乃是望仙宗两朵带刺的玫瑰花，惹得多少男弟子垂涎三尺。

顾倾城毫无风度的一屁股坐了下来，嘟着嘴道：“有什么落井下石的，姐姐你就是心善，要是我早就把其踹了，现在退婚刚合适。”
顾清影白了妹妹一眼，“你呀你呀，都开始修仙了，还不知道端庄矜持一些，行了，这件事情我以后会处理。”
两姐妹顾清影端庄稳重，顾倾城性格活泼做事不拘一格，还有几分调皮。
说到这里顾清影看了妹妹一眼，“以后别提他了，对了，你要加紧修炼了，争取尽快早点筑基。”
顾倾城吐了吐粉舌，“哦，知道了，姐姐快筑基了吧！”
顾清影点点头，“嗯，我这两天正在准备筑基，你这段时间不要来打扰。”
“啊！姐姐你真厉害，我才炼气七层。”顾倾城有些颓废的道。
就在这时郝建走了过来，柔声道：“倾城师妹来了。”
郝建一身白衣，身后背一把龙辰剑，长发遮眉，衣诀飘飘，潇洒自在，好似神仙中人。
顾倾城看见郝建顿时神色一喜，连忙站起身来，“郝师兄来了，你今天真帅！”
郝建点点头，来到顾清影面前眼底闪过一丝痴迷，柔声道：“师妹，师尊喊你过去，交代筑基的事情，你跟我来。”
顾清影站起身来随意拂了拂额前的秀发，“有劳师兄了！妹妹你先回去吧，要不等在这里也行，记住不要乱跑。”

"It turns out to be Senior Sister Xia. You are really good at joking. I am a useless person. How can I make elixirs? You must have made a mistake."
The fact that Chen Changsheng was able to recover the waste elixir must not be allowed to be known to anyone except Mr. Dan. Otherwise, it would be a fatal disaster, and he himself would definitely be used as a guinea pig for research.
"Oh, maybe I'm mistaken! Chen Changsheng, I've heard of your story. It's indeed very miserable. A man has to worry about not having a wife. By the way, if you have any difficulties in the future, you can go to the medicine garden to find me, which is not far from your useless elixir room."
Xia Yudie blinked at Chen Changsheng, showing a trace of kindness.
Chen Changsheng clasped his fists and said, "Thank you, Senior Sister Xia. I am deeply grateful. Senior Sister, walk slowly."
After Xia Yudie left, Chen Changsheng secretly breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he would have to be more careful in the future and try to recover the pills at night.
On the other side, in a sacred place of cultivation in Wangxian Sect, a woman flew with a sword and quickly landed at the door. It was Gu Qingying's sister Gu Qingcheng.
Qi refining disciples can also fly with swords, but they can only fly short distances, not far.
This is where Gu Qing Photographer's Gate is located. The scenery is stunning, with cranes dancing, elk grazing leisurely, exotic flowers and grasses all over the ground, fallen flowers blooming in color, the garden filled with fragrance, fairy mist curling up, and a rainbow fairy bridge.
What a holy land for cultivation. Compared with Chen Changsheng's shabby alchemy room, it was like a completely different world.
When the disciples guarding the mountain saw that it was Gu Qingcheng, they quickly let her in.
Entering the mountain gate, there is a unique cave inside, with pavilions and pavilions, colorful flowers, and waterfalls falling from the mountains in the distance, like a Milky Way.
Fairy birds are everywhere, koi carps are auspicious, lotuses are blooming, and flowers are falling from the sky.
"Sister, Chen Changsheng is such a loser. He actually dares to threaten to come to the house in person to break off the engagement in three months. It's a shame for him, isn't it?"
As soon as Gu Qingcheng came in, he saw his sister Gu Qingying sitting cross-legged in the pavilion and said angrily.
"He must be angry. Am I adding insult to injury by doing this?"
Gu Qingying raised her head, her eyebrows were raised, her eyes were moving, she had slender eyebrows with willow leaves, and white teeth and red lips. The two sisters were really competing for beauty together, and they were shy and shy.
The Gu family sisters were so beautiful that they were the two thorny roses of Wangxian Sect, which made many male disciples salivate.
Gu Qingcheng sat down gracelessly and pouted: "If you are trying to add insult to injury, sister, you are kind-hearted. If I had kicked her out, it is just right to break off the engagement now."
Gu Qingying rolled her eyes at her sister and said, "You, you, have started to practice immortality. You still don't know how to be more dignified and reserved. Okay, I will deal with this matter in the future."
The two sisters, Gu Qingying, are dignified and steady, while Gu Qingcheng is lively, unconventional and a bit naughty.
At this point, Gu Qingying glanced at her sister and said, "Don't mention him anymore. By the way, you have to step up your practice and strive to build the foundation as soon as possible."
Gu Qingcheng stuck out her pink tongue and said, "Oh, I see, sister is about to build the foundation!"
Gu Qingying nodded, "Well, I'm preparing to build the foundation these two days, so don't disturb me during this time."
"Ah! Sister, you are so powerful. I am only at the seventh level of Qi refining." Gu Qingcheng said a little decadently.
At this moment, Hao Jian came over and said softly: "Junior Sister Qingcheng is here."
Hao Jian is dressed in white, with a Long Chen Sword on his back. His long hair covers his eyebrows, and his clothes are fluttering. He looks carefree and at ease, like a fairy.
Gu Qingcheng suddenly looked happy when she saw Hao Jian, and stood up quickly, "Senior Brother Hao is here, you are so handsome today!"
Hao Jian nodded, came to Gu Qingying, a trace of obsession flashed in his eyes, and said softly: "Junior sister, Master called you over to explain the matter of foundation building, you andI'll come. "
Gu Qingying stood up and casually brushed her hair from her forehead, "Thank you, senior brother! Sister, please go back first, or you can wait here. Remember not to run around. "
